'''Pokémon All-Stars''' are a series of DVDs that were released by {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) for {{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}. Each single release contains a single disc with four episodes of {{aniseries|PTS}} about the Pokémon featured on the cover. The episodes are selected from the first 12 [[season]]s. The box sets combined three single releases into one box set. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. They are similar to the {{OBP|Pokémon All-Stars|Region 1}} series which was released in the United States by [[VIZ Media]]. ==Pokémon All-Stars: Triple Pack 1== [[File:Pokémon All-Stars Triple Pack 1 Region 4.jpg|thumb|200px|Pokémon All-Stars: Triple Pack 1]] The Pokémon All-Stars: Triple Pack 1 is the first box set of Pokémon All-Stars series. Individual volumes were released in July 2010.
